# practical-oss / 实用开源项目志

> Purpose-organized catalog of widely used open-source software. Each entry explains the problem it solves, core features, where it sits in a workflow, its boundaries, and its current license status (including projects that left OSI licenses, with forks noted). Text under CC BY 4.0. 按用途分类的实用开源项目志。

- Repository: https://github.com/jammyfu/practical-oss
- Machine-readable catalog: catalog/index.json; categories: catalog/categories.json
- All-time list: catalog/history.md; trending snapshots: catalog/trending/

## Reading guides
- en: https://github.com/jammyfu/practical-oss/blob/main/docs/README.en.md
- zh-CN: https://github.com/jammyfu/practical-oss/blob/main/docs/README.zh-CN.md
- zh-TW: https://github.com/jammyfu/practical-oss/blob/main/docs/README.zh-TW.md
- ja: https://github.com/jammyfu/practical-oss/blob/main/docs/README.ja.md
- ko: https://github.com/jammyfu/practical-oss/blob/main/docs/README.ko.md

These translate the reader guide only. Consult the repository README for corpus/UI language and licensing limitations.
